title: OFM model cache status
description: Payload of ofm/_system/cache/{runtime}: state of one runtime's model cache (ADR-0001). Published retained after every cache load and whenever the unmapped count changes.

ts.description: Time of the last successful cache load.

trigger.description: What caused the last load: startup (load from the database at start-up, also when the database answers after a start from the saved copy), notify (a model_changed notification, step 2.1), or disk (the database could not be reached at start-up, so the runtime started from its saved copy of the model, step 2.6).

savedAt.description: Only with trigger disk: when the saved copy was written, i.e. the time of the model the runtime is running on.

rows.description: Number of rows loaded from vw_runtime_model.

unmapped.description: Number of distinct unmapped (source, address) pairs seen since the last load.
